VS
Sayeda Hosena Khatun being dead her heirs, Rokeya Begum and others. ----- Respondents.
full_judgment: 2. Sayeda Hosena Khatun, the predecessor of the respondent Nos. 1(a) and 1(b), instituted the above suit praying for ejectment of the defendants from the suit premises and also recovery of khas possession of the same stating, inter alia, that her husband Syed Nurul Huda alias Elu Mia became the owner of the suit premises by purchasing the same from Syed Dudu Mir and Abu Mir, after his death she and her 1 son and 2 daughters became the owners of the suit land by inheritance; she inducted defendant Nos. 1 and 3 in suit premises as monthly ejectable tenants on the basis of two agreements; they, in violation of the agreements and without taking her consent sub let the suit premises in favour of defendant Nos.2, 4 and 5; then the defendant No.1 filed Title Suit No. 5 of 1998 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Akhaura, Brahmanbaria against the defendant No.3 including the defendant Nos. 2, 4 and 5 and also defendant Nos. 43, 56, 46, 48 and 63 for declaration of his title in the suit land which by judgment dated 29.9.1991 was decreed; as against that the above defendants filed Title Appeal No. 71 of 1991 which was dismissed for non-prosecution on 27.1.1992; the defendants are defaulters for non-payment of monthly rents; the plaintiff served notice up on the defendants under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act terminating the tenancy and asking them to vacate the suit premises but the defendants did not vacate and hence the suit.
